title: The Starving Wolf
text: A wolf with ribs showing like the staves of a barrel walks right up to the fire and sits, like a dog that wants feeding. Its tongue lolls. Its yellow eyes are very patient. Out in the dark nothing else moves, not yet.

options.label: Feed the wolf; a starving thing that asks so politely deserves a meal.

outcomes.text: It eats and lies down by the fire. In the morning it is gone, and its pack leads you a better way.

options.label: Drive it away from the fire before its pack grows bolder.

outcomes.text: It goes. Its pack watches from the trees all night.

options.label: The most blooded kills it for its pelt; it will starve no longer.

outcomes.text: The pelt is good. The pack does not forgive.
